name: Neural Network for Transfer Function Parameterization
aliases: Multilayer Feed-Forward Neural Network for 2D Histogram Pattern Recognition
definition: A neural network method that uses a trained multilayer feed-forward network to automatically determine the position and size of Gaussian filters for 2D transfer functions in volume rendering, based on input patterns from a 2D histogram of attenuation coefficient and gradient magnitude.
summary: This method uses a shallow neural network to automatically determine Gaussian filter parameters for volume rendering transfer functions, distinguishing itself by avoiding regression or large language models.
